title: Form layout
description: Where each field of a procedure's form goes on page 1 of its PDF, for filling a form that has no fillable fields, and where its signatures go on any page. layouts/<procedure id>/<form id>.json. Positions are PDF points from the top-left of the page; a rect is [x0, top, x1, bottom], the printed blank line's box. Field boxes are for page 1 only; a signature names its page. A layout is for one version of the form (sha256): when the form changes, it is measured again. What goes in each box is the procedure's; a layout only says where

sha256.description: The form's sha256, as in the procedure

font_size.description: Points; a consumer shrinks text that doesn't fit

boxes.description: One per field of the form, keyed by its label

continuation.description: More blank lines for text too long for rect, in order

cells.description: One character per cell, as for a codice fiscale: each cell's [x0, x1]

parts.description: A date written in parts (day, month, year), in that order

choices.description: Each box to tick, by the procedure's box name

write.description: Where the value goes for a box with write_value, by box name

table.description: A repeat field: the table's rows, and each column's [x0, x1] by the procedure's column label

into_table.description: An ask whose answers are more rows of another field's table, after that field's own

skip.description: Why nothing is written here (a box for the office)

signatures.description: Where the signer signs, and dates the signature if the form has a Data line beside it. Not fields: nothing the procedure maps fills them, only a signature a person approved. A form with signatures has signature_required in the procedure

date_rect.description: The Data line next to it, if the form has one

for.description: Who signs here: dichiarante, the person the procedure's form is made out for, unless the form names another signer

unmapped.description: Boxes on the form that no field fills, and why

needed_when.description: The box must be filled by hand when this box of a field is ticked
